selection: top 50 product codes by gross units sold (all countries) in the weeks 2009-12-07 .. 2011-06-13 only (before the first evaluation origin): later sales and survival into the test period play no part
target: net units per week = units sold minus units on cancellation invoices, netted into the week of the cancellation (the source rarely links a cancellation to its sale)
series_start: each series starts at its first week with sales; earlier weeks are absent, not zero
currency: GBP (retail selling prices; not used here and never relabelled EUR)
assumptions: exact duplicate lines (all eight fields equal) are counted once: the two sheets overlap in December 2010 and the source also repeats some lines within a sheet; a genuinely repeated identical purchase would be undercounted by this choice
available_at = week start + 7 days (the source has no availability time)
cancellations netted into the week they occur
weeks with no line = 0 units (a transaction log records every sale, so an empty week is no sales, not missing)
